title: Wedjat: Detecting Sophisticated Evasion Attacks via Real-time Causal Analysis

problem.claim: Encrypted traffic can be abused to deliver malicious traffic, while evasion attacks can manipulate traffic to obscure features and evade existing detection methods.

gap.claim: Robust detection of encrypted malicious traffic against evasion attacks remains an open problem.

contributions.claim: Wedjat uses a causal network to model benign packet interactions among relevant flows and identify abnormal or disrupted causality associated with malicious traffic and evasion attacks.
Wedjat provides real-time packet-level detection with a reported prediction latency below 0.125 seconds per packet.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors evaluated Wedjat using millions of flows collected from a real-world enterprise.
The authors report a 0.957 F1-score for detecting various advanced attacks.
The authors report that five sophisticated evasion attacks were detected with over 0.915 F1 and characterize the system as exceptionally robust against evasions.

narrative_sequence.summary: Traffic encryption protects Internet traffic confidentiality and integrity but can also be abused for malicious delivery.
Existing encrypted-traffic detection methods are vulnerable to feature-obfuscating evasion attacks, leaving robust detection unresolved.
Wedjat applies causal modeling of benign packet interactions to recognize malicious abnormal causality and evasion-induced disrupted causality.
The system was evaluated on millions of enterprise flows and reported strong detection performance against advanced and sophisticated evasion attacks.
The authors report packet prediction latency below 0.125 seconds.

source_observation.claim: The method models relationships among packet interactions and relevant flows rather than relying only on obfuscatable traffic features.

interpretation.claim: Modeling causal structure may provide a way to improve resilience when attackers manipulate observable features.

application.claim: For adversarial detection tasks, consider representing stable interaction or dependency structure alongside surface-level features.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether causal modeling improves robustness across settings beyond the reported enterprise evaluation.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the causal-network construction, training procedure, or deployment architecture.
The abstract does not identify the compared existing methods, attack datasets or distributions, or evaluation protocol.
The abstract does not provide confidence intervals, per-attack results, or details supporting the reported robustness.
